title: Index: Troubleshooting
summary: Diagnose common Index failures by shrinking the loop and testing one fix.

blocks.title: Common Failure
blocks.body: If a record is missing, check that the owning addon is loaded and reopen Index after resources reload.

blocks.title: Reset The Loop
blocks.body: If a record is missing, check filters, spelling, addon availability, and whether the content is documented as an Index entry rather than a Wiki article.

blocks.title: One Fix At A Time
blocks.body: Change one variable, run a smaller test, and compare the result. Fixing three things at once can hide the part that actually mattered.

blocks.title: Retest Cleanly
blocks.body: Change one variable, test on a smaller route, and keep the fix only if the failure becomes easier to explain.
